# Arborist North Vancouver

> An independent educational resource helping North Vancouver homeowners make informed decisions about tree care. We connect homeowners with qualified local certified arborists — we are not a tree service company.

## Services

- [Find an Arborist](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/find-arborist.html): Free assessment tool to match homeowners with qualified local arborists in North Vancouver.
- [Tree Removal](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/tree-removal.html): When removal is necessary, permit requirements, typical costs ($500–$5,000+), and safety considerations.
- [Tree Pruning](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/tree-pruning.html): Best timing, techniques, costs, and when to hire a certified arborist vs. DIY.
- [Emergency Tree Services](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/emergency-tree.html): 24/7 emergency response for storm damage, fallen trees, and immediate hazards. Call 778-200-9610.

## Permits & Regulations

- [Tree Permits Overview](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/permits.html): Whether your property falls under City of North Vancouver (CNV) or District of North Vancouver (DNV) rules.
- [DNV Tree Permit Guide](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/permits-dnv.html): District of North Vancouver requirements under Bylaw 7671. Permit required for trees 75cm+ diameter, near streams, steep slopes, ravines, or protected species. Fee: $300.
- [CNV Tree Permit Guide](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/permits-cnv.html): City of North Vancouver requirements under Tree Bylaw No. 8888. Rules vary by zoning. Topping prohibited.

## Pricing

- [Tree Service Pricing](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/pricing.html): Typical costs for tree removal, pruning, stump grinding, and emergency services in North Vancouver.

## About

- [About Us](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/about.html): Independent educational resource. Not affiliated with any tree service company.
- [Contact](https://arboristnorthvancouver.com/contact.html): Phone: 778-200-9610 | Email: arboristnorthvancouver@gmail.com

## Key Facts

- Trees over 20cm diameter typically require permits to remove in North Vancouver
- Unpermitted tree removal fines can reach $10,000
- Protected species include Arbutus, Garry Oak, and Pacific Yew
- Arborists should carry minimum $2M liability insurance and WorkSafeBC coverage
- Service areas: North Vancouver, West Vancouver, Vancouver, Sea to Sky Corridor
